name: Texture Synthesizer 2
description: This algorithm is an implementation of the open source Beads module by Émilie Gillet. This implementation should behave and sound identical to the original. Any demos or tutorials you may find online should apply just as well to this version. The user manual for the original module is available at the Mutable Instruments documentation. The documentation below assumes some familiarity with this. The Beads hardware runs by default at 48kHz, but switches to 32kHz in its 'Cold digital' mode and 24kHz in its 'Scorched cassette' mode. For a genuine Beads experience, set the disting NT's engine to 48kHz, or to 32kHz for 'Cold digital'. The NT does not support running the hardware at 24kHz, but we use an option in the Beads source code to emulate 24kHz when the hardware is at 48kHz.

parameters.name: Freeze
parameters.description: Freezes the audio; the same as the Freeze button on the Beads module.

parameters.name: Latch
parameters.description: Enables Latched grain generation; enabled on the hardware Beads by pressing Freeze and Seed together.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.description: Generates grains; the same as the Seed button on the Beads module.

parameters.name: Density
parameters.description: Recreates the function of the Density pot on Beads.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Sets the recording quality (and buffer length).

parameters.name: Channels
parameters.description: Sets mono or stereo operation.

parameters.name: Synth mode
parameters.description: Enables synth mode (what Beads does when there are no input cables patched).

parameters.name: Resolution
parameters.description: Sets the resolution for synth mode.

parameters.name: Input gain
parameters.description: Sets the input gain, or enables automatic gain control. The AGC is reset when entering or leaving synth mode, and when changing between mono and stereo operation.

parameters.name: Output mode
parameters.description: The standard Add/Replace mode selector.
